points.text: M1: organic product for Cl: $\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{COCH}_2\text{Cl}$ – chlorine atom(s) in side chain only
M2: name of mechanism for Cl: free radical substitution
M3: organic product for nitric / sulfuric: $\text{C}_6\text{H}_4(\text{O}_2\text{N})\text{COCH}_3$ – one only $\text{-NO}_2$ group added at 3 position
M4: name of mechanism for nitric / sulfuric: electrophilic substitution

points.guidance: Award 1 mark for each correct entry to the table [5]

points.text: M1: first structure – two points correct from: correct polarity shown on $\text{C=O}$ bond; curly arrow from double bond to O of the $\text{C=O}$; lone pair shown on C of $\text{CN}^{-}$ ion; curly arrow from C (on $\text{CN}^{-}$ ion) to C of $\text{C=O}$
points.guidance: M1 and M2: first structure – award one mark for two points correct, award two marks for four points correct

points.text: M2: first structure – four points correct: correct polarity on $\text{C=O}$ AND curly arrow from double bond to O AND lone pair on C of $\text{CN}^{-}$ AND curly arrow from C of $\text{CN}^{-}$ to C of $\text{C=O}$
M3: middle structure – correct intermediate AND curly arrow from lone pair on $\text{O}^{-}$ to $\text{H}^{+}$ or H of $\text{H}_2\text{O}$ or $\text{HCN}$
M4: third structure – correct product AND either $\text{CN}^{-}$ reformed (if $\text{HCN}$ seen in step 2) OR curly arrow on $\text{H-CN}$ bond towards CN in step 2
M1: $\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{C}(\text{CH}_3)(\text{H})\text{OH}$ – benzene ring attached to C with $\text{CH}_3$, OH and H
M1: any two correct chemical shift ranges from: 25–50 AND 110–160 AND 190–220
M2: all three correct: 25–50 AND 110–160 AND 190–220
